title: How Did Travellers Reach Madeira Before the Airport?
description: By ship, then by flying boat. Until Madeira airport opened on 8 July 1964, visitors came on liners anchored in Funchal bay, on seaplanes, or via Porto Santo.
heroAlt: A passenger ship lying at anchor in Funchal bay at dawn, a small launch heading to the harbour
keywords: how did travellers reach madeira before the airport

images.prompt: Dawn in Funchal bay, Madeira, photographed from water level about a kilometre offshore. A large white passenger ship lies at anchor in the middle of the bay, not at the quay, its lights still on. A small launch with a white wake heads from it towards the long Pontinha breakwater on the left. Behind, the amphitheatre of Funchal climbs the green hillside in the first pink and gold light, the sea calm and silvery. No people visible, true colours, realistic photo, no text.
